summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Global Financials ETF (IXG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in financials equity. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index of large- and mid-cap global financial stocks. IXG was launched on Nov 12, 2001 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: IXG is an equity ETF with a total of 250 individual holdings. The top holdings are Berkshire Hathaway stock at 6.08%, JPMorgan Chase & Co. at 5.81%, Visa Inc. at 4.07%, Mastercard at 2.99%, and Bank of America at 2.34%.
